description.en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance in Serverless mode.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including instance IDs.

description.zh:
在数据共享中添加或移除实例。取值说明：

- **add**：将实例添加至数据共享中。
- **remove**：将实例从数据共享中移除。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable data sharing. Valid values:

*   **add**: enables data sharing.
*   **remove**: disables data sharing.

description.zh:
地域ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~86912~~)接口查看可用的地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 将实例加入或移出数据共享
title.en: Add or remove an instance from data sharing

descriptions.zh: 仅Serverless实例支持数据共享功能。
descriptions.en: Only Serverless instances support the data sharing feature.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb set-data-share-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --operation-type add --instance-list gp-bp000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
